summary: Register Auto.ru as a classified vehicle provider with bounded dealer-offer reads, NEW/USED XML feed submission and asynchronous feed-task status.

impacts.evidence: One tenant-bound connector Account resolves one configured Auto.ru account_id and optional dealer_id; caller publication/listing requests cannot override account identity.
Task 038 projects dealer inventory metadata and task counters only. Authorization/session secrets stay callback-scoped and raw provider response text is not propagated.
Task 038 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Connector SDK v1 gains additive provider-neutral classified publication request/receipt/status interfaces and capabilities; frozen Connector and Runtime roots remain unchanged.
No migration is added; remote task/listing identities remain host-owned mapping/audit evidence.
Fixed apiauto.ru authority, Task-021 secret callback, exact dealer account health binding, HTTPS source/image constraints, bounded task IDs/bodies and normalized errors enforce the provider boundary.
Listing/status operations are read risk; classified.publications.write is explicitly write_sensitive and remains host-policy/approval gated.
The adapter returns bounded remote listing and feed-task observations/receipts only; host audit, approval and mapping evidence remains authoritative.

Feed status counters support reconciliation. Feed submission has no qualified caller idempotency key, so transport/write-side 5xx ambiguity fails closed as write_outcome_unknown without automatic retry.
Outbound provider API authority is fixed to apiauto.ru; source XML/image URLs are validated separately and webhook subscription is not admitted.
Rate limits/service failures are normalized with retry guidance only for retry-safe reads; write ambiguity is non-retryable.
Suspend/disable the Auto.ru connector account to stop traffic; no schema rollback is required.
Deterministic tests cover current response shapes, exact account health, vehicle XML mapping, submit/status and ambiguous writes; Task-064 provider candidate passes all thirteen checks.
